verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency can publish its statutory fee amounts, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes, which were respected, so none of the Commission's fee pages were fetched and nothing shows published fee amounts. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none, not na. Confidence is low because this reflects missing evidence, not a documented failure.
